title: Set 85

sentences.ko: 배송조회에 아직도 배송 중이라고 떠 있는데 그게 화요일이야. 그러니까 어디 트럭에 그대로 실려 있든가 누가 다른 건물에 놓고 갔든가 둘 중 하나지. 그렇다고 하나 더 주문할 수도 없는 게, 토요일 생일 선물이거든. 너희 집 초인종은 돼? 우리 건 여름부터 안 되는데, 그게 진짜 문제인 것 같다는 생각이 들기 시작했어.
sentences.text: The tracking still says out for delivery, and that was Tuesday, so either it's sitting in a truck somewhere or somebody dropped it at the wrong building. And I can't just order another one, because it's a birthday thing for Saturday. Is your buzzer working? Because mine hasn't worked since the summer and I'm starting to think that's the whole problem.

alts.text: Tracking's been saying out for delivery since Tuesday, so it's either stuck on a truck somewhere or somebody left it at the wrong building. And I can't just buy another one, it's a birthday thing for Saturday. Does your buzzer work? Mine's been dead since the summer and I'm kinda starting to think that's the whole problem.

The tracking information still shows out for delivery, and that was Tuesday, so either the package is sitting in a truck somewhere or someone delivered it to the wrong building. I cannot simply order another one, because it is a birthday gift for Saturday. Is your buzzer working? Mine has not worked since the summer, and I am beginning to think that is the entire problem.

sentences.note: **out for delivery** 는 물건이 배송 기사에게 넘어가 오늘 배달될 예정이라는 배송조회 상태 표시입니다. **buzzer** 는 건물 공동현관에서 눌러 안에 있는 사람을 부르는 초인종입니다.

sentences.ko: 일주일 내내 잘 지키고 있었거든. 그러다 목요일에 누가 도넛을 사 왔는데, 반 개만 먹자고 스스로 다짐했어. 두 개 먹었지. 그러고는 어차피 오늘은 망했다 싶어서 그날 저녁엔 피자를 시켰어. 나를 무너뜨리는 건 도넛이 아니야. 항상 도넛 다음에 오는 것들이지.
sentences.text: I was doing fine all week, and then somebody brought donuts in on Thursday and I told myself I'd have half of one. I had two. And then I figured the day was already shot, so we ordered pizza that night. It's never the donut that gets me, it's everything after the donut.

alts.text: All week I was totally fine, and then Thursday somebody brings in donuts and I go, okay, half of one. I had two. And then I figured the day was already blown, so we got pizza that night. It's never the donut that gets me, it's everything after the donut.

I was doing well all week, and then someone brought donuts in on Thursday and I told myself I would have half of one. I had two. I then decided the day was already ruined, so we ordered pizza that evening. It is never the donut that undoes me, it is everything that comes after the donut.

sentences.note: **the day was already shot** 은 그날 하루는 이미 망했다는 뜻으로, shot 이 못 쓰게 됐다는 뜻의 구어입니다. **that gets me** 는 나를 무너뜨리는 건 그것이다, 나한테는 그게 통한다는 뜻입니다.

sentences.ko: 폰이 자꾸 한 사십 퍼센트쯤에서 꺼져. 그러고 충전기를 꽂으면 이십 퍼센트라고 뜨고. 그래서 이제 실제로 몇 퍼센트인지를 모르겠어. 게다가 꼭 밖에 나와 있을 때만 이러고, 집에서 충전기 바로 옆에 앉아 있을 때는 절대 안 그래. 그냥 배터리 문제인 것 같아, 아니면 수리 맡겨야 할까?
sentences.text: My phone keeps shutting off at like forty percent, and then I plug it in and it says twenty, so I don't actually know what it's at anymore. And it only does it when I'm out somewhere, never at home when I'm sitting next to a charger. Do you think that's just the battery, or should I take it in?

alts.text: Something's up with my phone, it keeps dying at like forty percent, then I plug it in and it says twenty, so I don't even know what it's at anymore. And it only pulls this when I'm out somewhere, never at home when I'm sitting right next to a charger. You think it's just the battery, or should I take it in?

My phone continues to shut off at around forty percent, and then I plug it in and it reads twenty, so I no longer know what it is actually at. It only does this when I am out somewhere, never at home when I am sitting beside a charger. Do you think that is simply the battery, or should I bring it in?

sentences.note: **take it in** 은 고장 난 물건을 수리받으러 가져간다는 뜻입니다. 캐주얼의 **it only pulls this** 는 꼭 이럴 때만 이런 짓을 한다는 느낌으로, 물건을 사람처럼 말할 때 씁니다.

sentences.ko: 오 분만 있으려고 애 옆에 누웠는데 열 시 반에 깼어. 애 머리에 깔린 팔은 완전히 감각이 없고 집 안 불은 다 켜진 채로. 그래서 설거지는 아직 싱크대에 그대로 있고 너희 어머니한테 전화도 다시 못 드렸어. 그냥 방에서 나와서 십 분쯤 울게 두면 된다는 거 알아. 그런데 그게 나는 안 돼.
sentences.text: I laid down next to him for what was supposed to be five minutes, and I woke up at ten thirty with my arm completely dead under his head and every light in the house still on. So the dishes are still in the sink and I never called your mom back. I know I could just leave the room and let him cry for ten minutes, but I can't make myself do it.

alts.text: I was just gonna lie down with him for five minutes, and next thing I know it's ten thirty, my arm's totally dead under his head and every light in the house is still on. So the dishes are still in the sink and I never called your mom back. I know I could just walk out and let him cry for ten minutes, but I can't make myself do it.

I lay down beside him for what was meant to be five minutes, and I woke at ten thirty with my arm completely numb beneath his head and every light in the house still on. As a result, the dishes are still in the sink and I never returned your mother's call. I know I could simply leave the room and allow him to cry for ten minutes, but I cannot bring myself to do it.

sentences.note: **my arm completely dead** 는 눌려서 감각이 없어진, 저린 팔을 말합니다. **I can't make myself do it** 은 방법을 몰라서가 아니라 마음이 안 먹어져서 못 하겠다는 뜻입니다.

sentences.ko: 자, 너는 요즘 어떻게 지내? 마지막으로 들은 게 언니네로 들어갈지도 모른다는 거였는데, 그러고 나서 넉 달쯤 연락이 뚝 끊겼잖아. 아직 그 집에 살아? 처음부터 끝까지 다 듣고 싶어. 나 시간 많아.
sentences.text: Okay, so what's going on with you? Because last I heard you were maybe moving in with your sister, and then you went quiet on me for like four months. Are you still at the same place? I want the whole story, I'm not in a hurry.

alts.text: So what's new with you? Last I heard you were maybe gonna move in with your sister, and then you went quiet on me for like four months. You still at the same place? I want the whole story, I'm in no rush.

So, what has been happening with you? The last I heard, you were possibly moving in with your sister, and then I did not hear from you for about four months. Are you still at the same place? I would like the whole story, and I am not in a hurry.

sentences.note: **you went quiet on me** 는 연락이 뚝 끊겼다는 뜻이고, on me 가 붙어서 나만 두고 그랬다는 서운함이 들어갑니다. **last I heard** 는 내가 마지막으로 들은 바로는 이라는 뜻입니다.

reviewed: 1번 한국어 '그게 문제의 전부인 것 같다' 가 번역투라 '그게 진짜 문제인 것 같다' 로 고쳤습니다.
2번 note 가 **it gets me** 를 짚었는데 문장에는 'that gets me' 로 나옵니다. 실제로 나오는 표현으로 맞췄습니다.
4번 casual 의 'I got in next to him' 은 어디에 들어갔다는 건지 흐려서, 'I was just gonna lie down with him for five minutes' 로 다시 썼습니다. 겸사겸사 text 와 시작이 겹치지 않게 하고 말투도 더 구어로 내렸습니다.
